dialogues.speaker: Georg
dialogues.text: Angel's Share participates in Weinlesefest each time, and plenty of folk come all the way here to Mondstadt to sample our limited-edition wines.

dialogues.speaker: Georg
dialogues.text: Back when Master Crepus was around, he'd come to us in person every year to drink a glass...

dialogues.speaker: Georg
dialogues.text: *sigh* I don't know why, but this festival always makes me nostalgic.

dialogues.speaker: Georg
dialogues.text: Diluc... I mean, Master Diluc has had a rough go of it these past few years, but he seems to be in good spirits this year.

dialogues.speaker: Georg
dialogues.text: As long as Master Diluc is well, I'm sure Master Crepus' spirit up above will also be pleased.
